row.body: on the back: “the second evening, an acrid film in the weathered bundle after the insecticide test. the tomato plants curled. later, a checkpoint opened.”
row.title: weathered bundle note — the second evening

sidecar.gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
sidecar.rival_reading: Responders could have collected the an acrid film while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
